leg_index_convention: 0-based array indices into the tests array; every leg reference also carries issue_id and ac (WAL 1240 W2)
generated_by: python3 docs/tools/leg_path_pin_audit.py --index docs/state/merge_test_index.json (t107-upgraded auditor), observations parsed from the run's own pin lines; the stamp is a hashlib measurement of the index bytes, not a quoted literal

index_stamp.normalization: CRLF is folded to LF (b.replace(b'\r\n', b'\n')) before hashing, so a core.autocrlf=true worktree and the stored git blob agree; the worktree's raw bytes differ from the normalized bytes hashed here
index_stamp.provenance_note: provenance only - every fence on this card derives its comparison base at run time from the branch shape (t102 lesson, WAL 1221/1222); no fence quotes this field or any digest literal

replay_contract: This record is a snapshot of the STAMPED index blob (index_stamp.git_blob_id). Replaying the auditor against a DIFFERENT index blob is expected to mismatch, and such a mismatch says nothing about the tool; --against-record is the instrument that classifies every observation difference against the declared stamp as EXPECTED (stamp mismatch, exit 0) or DRIFT (same-blob disagreement, AGAINST-RECORD GATE, exit 1). A record with no index_stamp cannot be classified and is reported UNSTAMPED.
supersedes_note: COMPANION record, not a replacement: docs/state/outputs/t104_hygiene_findings.json (t104 custody) and docs/state/outputs/t106_checker_b64_findings.json (t106 custody) stay byte-FROZEN - this card REJECTED regenerating either, and ac2 proves byte-identity. This record COMPLEMENTS them by being the first record under docs/state/outputs/ that carries an index_stamp and a replay_contract, so a future replay can tell WHICH index blob it describes; the historical records remain the evidence their cards shipped with.
zero_index_bytes: t107 writes ZERO bytes of docs/state/merge_test_index.json; the stamp is MEASURED from the index bytes, never stored in them. The WAL 1248 W2 8-property index-amendment policy is NOT invoked and no written amendment is made.
